edi-proposed-v1.ownership: Each owner commits only its own state domain; persistent authorities and boundary distinctions are specified in CONTRACTS.md sections 1â€“3. Shared DB access does not confer cross-owner write rights.
edi-proposed-v1.authority: Read, propose, admit and execute are separate operation classes. Matrix operation lists and owner rules apply; simulated or model-generated output never authorizes real effects.
edi-proposed-v1.shape_versions: CommandEnvelope/ResultEnvelope and referenced record types in CONTRACTS.md sections 2â€“4; incompatible major/required capabilities reject without mutation. Concrete JSON schemas remain a contract-gate obligation.
edi-proposed-v1.identity_scope: Workspace-scoped opaque identities; preserve occurrence/payload/source-epoch/referent distinctions, selector and derivation lineage. Association corrections append a decision rather than rewriting sources.
edi-proposed-v1.time_order: Carry valid/event/received/known/commit times as available, unknown/clock uncertainty and source sequence/gaps. Pin query and actor knowledge cuts; no global physical ordering is inferred. Growth extension: result eligibility includes dependency revisions, evidence-known-at cut, projection watermark and caller freshness policy; a stale view cannot silently count as current.
edi-proposed-v1.delivery_idempotency: Retry-stable request ID plus fingerprint for mutations; conflicting key reuse rejects. At-least-once notification is permitted. Result lanes return original committed outcomes or explicit unknown_completion.
edi-proposed-v1.commit_recovery: Local owner transaction and outbox; reference artifacts only after their declared durable stage. Optimistic model revision, job leases/fences and completion reconciliation prevent stale or repeated effects. ModelDelta projection maintenance commits applied-event IDs and local checkpoints consistently; large invalidation closures are explicit bounded repair jobs, never silently complete.
edi-proposed-v1.retention: Refs obey the selected profile and holds; expired evidence returns unavailable/tombstone. Dependent claims/projections are invalidated or marked limited. No unlimited replay guarantee.
edi-proposed-v1.resource_limits: DEV1 bounds reads (100 default/1000 or 8 MiB maximum), job wall/work/token/bytes budgets and concurrency. Return partial/continuation/truncation explicitly; protect native intake from discretionary inquiry. FAST1 supplements DEV1 with bounded active context/delta shapes and useful-result latency targets; deep/global work and fresh-answer completion are measured separately. Acquisition requests are deduplicated and reuse existing scoped grants.
edi-proposed-v1.errors: Typed unsupported/unavailable/denied/conflict/timeout/cancelled/capacity_exceeded/integrity_mismatch/stale_projection/not_identifiable/unknown_completion with owner, retryability and durable partial refs.
edi-proposed-v1.feedback_grounding: Preserve source/derivation/common-evidence lineage, imported assistance, actual versus simulated origin and selection history. Proposals, summaries and simulation outputs do not become independent observations. Jev/model confidence is not independent evidence or proof that the option set covers every mechanism. Coarse/fine summaries and learned decisions have explicit validity/refinement contracts.

contracts.title: Acquisition control and evidence status requests

facets.ownership: C1 owns raw bytes; C4 owns rejections, responses and provisional memory; C0 schedules only admitted revisions; C7 owns the standing grant. See TEACHING_RECOVERY.md.
facets.authority: Rejected draft stays unaccepted, never creates candidates/frontier/actions. Teacher critiques only; optional public-manual names cannot exceed granted operations. Broker validates actual effects.
facets.identity_scope: Rejection job/raw-record/context IDs remain exact; source IDs and occurrences remain distinct. Public manual belongs to original operator grant fingerprint, not generated evidence.
facets.shape_versions: C0 integrated-1.8 fresh workspace, existing RejectedResponse and Job rejected status reused. Provisional memory allows null draft_response_id with explicit rejected_draft_records. SimulationGrant public_operations is optional; embedded mission catalogue takes precedence.
facets.time_order: Independent teacher allocation precedes draft; critique waits for completed independent assessment and definite draft completion/rejection. Revision follows critique against the same cut; evaluator runs only after controller termination.
facets.delivery_idempotency: Existing native command/gateway journals retained. Returned rejected draft bypasses a blind correction and reaches teaching; file-teacher pause/reopen never resends the original draft. Unknown completion cannot become a rejection or be replayed.
facets.commit_recovery: C4 commits raw rejection before critique eligibility; C0 dispatches admitted revision only and records actual outcome. Per-owner native reopen is checked; cross-owner crash/service recovery remains unqualified.
facets.retention: Raw failures, admitted revision and critique retained; lesson references failed draft directly. Pause checkpoint retains native state/Python/public startup text; immutable world assets remain in pinned original launch bundle with hashes.
facets.resource_limits: Existing six-job/four-round cap, exact 16384 input/4096 output admission, one revision correction, 24 turns/786432 policy units/one hour/64 public requests. Unknown usage charged full reservation; raw rejection excerpt capped at 8192 bytes with completeness flag.
facets.errors: Malformed/invalid returned draft may be reviewed; invalid revision remains bounded and stops without action. Pending provider completion, excess usage and storage/capacity faults do not masquerade as draft content errors.
facets.feedback_grounding: Blind firsts exclude current peer outputs/rejections. Critique/revision may see generated rejected draft with diagnostic, never world-evidence authority. Same-source repeat still requires purpose. Cedar private state/future/evaluator are not coaching inputs; advice and lessons remain provisional.

cases.title: Mixed native capture and duplicate payloads.
cases.acceptance: Text, image, waveform, structured numeric and an unknown composite retain byte hashes, order and distinct genuine occurrences; replayed notification does not duplicate an occurrence.

cases.title: Restart between byte staging and metadata commit.
cases.acceptance: No false durable receipt, no missing acknowledged artifact, detectable/recoverable orphan or incomplete manifest, and no repeated committed occurrence.

cases.title: Long-gap identity and source epoch reset.
cases.acceptance: Stable binding survives a simulated two-year interval; replacement/reset is explicit; ambiguous physical continuity remains unknown rather than silently merged.

cases.title: Cross-modal false association and reversal.
cases.acceptance: Similar text/image candidates do not force a merge; split/correction preserves sources and invalidates dependent views.

cases.title: Event versus structure and source dependence.
cases.acceptance: Direct structural inspection and reported event are represented on independent role/basis axes; rephrased copies remain one source lineage.

cases.title: Temporal semantics, late arrival and actor visibility.
cases.acceptance: Known-at cuts exclude later reports; gaps and uncertain time persist; actors cannot use analyst-only or future information.

cases.title: Units, ordinal values and conversions.
cases.acceptance: Incompatible dimensional equations are rejected; allowed conversions retain meaning; ordinal/unknown values are not silently treated as numeric or zero.

cases.title: Composition and overlapping system views.
cases.acceptance: Shared referent/resource appears once in accounting; query boundaries and external input closure remain explicit.

cases.title: Multi-input nonlinear law.
cases.acceptance: One joint mechanism with domain/rivals is retained; unsupported independent edge coefficients are not substituted.

cases.title: Stock-flow accounting and shared constraints.
cases.acceptance: Transfers balance under declared conversions/losses and capacity is consumed once; conflicting simultaneous demand is resolved by the declared rule.

cases.title: Delays, backlog and state carry-over.
cases.acceptance: Same visible stock with different pending commitments gives the appropriately different forecast; topology change preserves relevant backlog.

cases.title: Loop closure, sign and changing dominance.
cases.acceptance: Open paths are not labeled complete loops; sign is conditional; saturated or dormant mechanisms do not retain an unsupported fixed gain.

cases.title: Scope/interpretation and stakeholder criteria.
cases.acceptance: Causal scope, interests, qualitative concerns, local/wider horizons and disagreements remain distinct; no compulsory global utility is invented.

cases.title: Rival mechanism and non-identifiability.
cases.acceptance: Several structures fitting present data remain alternatives; the system proposes a distinguishing observation or reports non-identifiability.

cases.title: Curiosity against noisy novelty.
cases.acceptance: Test selection favors feasible useful discrimination over uninformative random noise; heuristic utility is not presented as calibrated information gain.

cases.title: System-of-systems boundary expansion.
cases.acceptance: Consequential interface frontier is exposed one supported link at a time; omitted drivers and duplicate accounting are detected; resource ceilings cause explicit defer/truncation.

cases.title: Restricted compilation and unsupported laws.
cases.acceptance: Invalid operators/references/units or missing backend capability fail before execution; a qualitative unknown does not generate a precise fabricated trajectory.

cases.title: Numerical refinement and discontinuity.
cases.acceptance: Solutions stabilize under declared step/tolerance refinement, balance diagnostics and threshold-event fixtures; unsupported delay/DAE semantics are explicit.

cases.title: Hybrid event and shared clock.
cases.acceptance: Event ties, continuous advancement, resource contention and pending updates follow one pinned policy without double application.

cases.title: Prospective forecast seal and outcome correspondence.
cases.acceptance: Original model/cut/forecast/scoring rule is immutable; new independent outcomes match quantities/units/time; edited forecasts cannot replace old ones.

cases.title: Synthetic evidence echo through a full loop.
cases.acceptance: Generated, summarized, exported and reimported simulation artifacts remain generated and cannot become independent corroboration.

cases.title: Calibration, missing outcomes and uncertainty.
cases.acceptance: Missing/censored data remain explicit; numeric scores are only computed for declared suitable quantities; coverage claims state dependence/stationarity assumptions.

cases.title: Error diagnosis and controlled revision.
cases.acceptance: Numerical, source, semantic, driver, parameter, rule and topology explanations remain distinguishable; revision records rationale and affected dependencies.

cases.title: Repair and finite shared support.
cases.acceptance: Repair uses the same resource authority as competing work, takes time and can fail; stable output with eroding restorative capacity remains visible.

cases.title: Real reorganization versus model correction.
cases.acceptance: Membership/rewiring history, actual-world evidence and model reinterpretation have different operation types and preserve state.

cases.title: Bounded actor response and failed execution.
cases.acceptance: Intention uses perceived options; realized effects obey actual modeled capacity; no automatic optimal response or goal success is assumed.

cases.title: Eight traps, leverage and adverse transitions.
cases.acceptance: Trap labels require mechanism evidence/rivals; interventions specify direction, adoption, time/resources, carry-over and wider/adverse consequences.

cases.title: Policy monitoring, authority and standard integrity.
cases.acceptance: Fixed response, amendment proposal, adoption and analyst revision stay separate; refusal/defer is possible; old criteria cannot be silently weakened.

cases.title: Action dispatch and uncertain completion.
cases.acceptance: Unauthorized dispatch is denied; idempotent reconciliation prevents duplicate permitted effects; a receipt remains distinct from observed effect.

cases.title: Proactive strategic finding.
cases.acceptance: A configured internal finding carries novel decision relevance, mechanism/evidence chain, uncertainty, horizon and test suggestion; duplicates are suppressed without masking a material update.

cases.title: Selective acquisition and bias.
cases.acceptance: Selection/exposure/cost lineage is preserved; unvisited or unavailable evidence is not treated as absent or as confirmation.

cases.title: Schema/embedding migration and stale projection.
cases.acceptance: Incompatible versions are rejected or explicitly migrated; old/current views do not silently mix; authoritative cutoff queries bypass or expose stale indexes.

cases.title: Retention and restore.
cases.acceptance: Tombstones and unavailable refs propagate; acknowledged data and forecasts restore with their histories at a declared coherent point.

cases.title: Queue saturation and model outage.
cases.acceptance: Native intake stays within the declared capacity/spool profile; bounded reasoning yields; overload and freshness lag remain visible and counted.

cases.title: Lease fencing, duplicate/reorder and concurrent revision.
cases.acceptance: A stale worker or stale base revision cannot overwrite a newer commit; unknown completion is reconciled and outputs remain idempotent.

cases.title: Matched persistent-learning comparison.
cases.acceptance: Same base model, observations/tools and accounting; include reset, unrelated and conventional-memory controls; report all pinned outcomes without a predetermined winner.

cases.title: Failure to fit or transfer under regime shift.
cases.acceptance: New operating point/parameters/rules/topology/input/measurement are challenged separately; unsupported transfer is withheld and failures remain logged.

cases.title: Whole-path resource accounting.
cases.acceptance: Offered/admitted/failing work, all token/media/tool/retry costs and wall time reconcile; unknown usage is not zero; energy claims require instrumentation.

cases.title: HA fault-domain and partition profile.
cases.acceptance: Only under an implemented HA1 topology: eligible request, durability, fencing, byte/reference consistency and failover results satisfy the pinned SLO/RPO/RTO and fault conditions.

cases.title: Provider/backend replacement.
cases.acceptance: Alternate provider or engine respects the same record/status/permission semantics; a version or quality change reopens qualification rather than silently inheriting results.

cases.title: Incremental correctness and locality under store growth.
cases.acceptance: At the FAST1 sizes, delta/retraction and incremental views match a separately recomputed authoritative reference for the same cutoff; record actual touched work and warm/cold latency. Q1/Q2 and growth targets apply only to their declared operation shapes.

cases.title: Fast decision quality, batching and escalation.
cases.acceptance: Compare Jev, deterministic and appropriate small/generative alternatives on matched bounded contexts; pin selective error/calibration and coverage before exposure. Include missing correct option, dependence between questions, OOD inputs and timeouts. No model output bypasses deterministic constraints.

cases.title: Global fan-out and stale-cache containment.
cases.acceptance: A high-degree/shared driver invalidates all declared dependents; bounded processing exposes remaining backlog. A warm stale cached result cannot be silently returned as fresh or used beyond its permitted policy.

cases.title: Coarse/fine abstraction and nonlinear aggregation.
cases.acceptance: Refinement bridges preserve units, time, identity, resource/count semantics and commitments. Demonstrate valid coarse reuse and a counterexample where heterogeneity/thresholds require refinement; compare supported output ranges.

cases.title: Missing access, standing grants and request fatigue.
cases.acceptance: Reuse an existing scoped grant; create an evidence-specific missing-access request; coalesce duplicates; honor denial/expiry; enforce notification policy and record useful/inconclusive acquisition outcomes.

cases.title: Breadth and depth expansion in one evolving world.
cases.acceptance: Start with forest observations, add an adjacent logging/market view and internal insect-life-stage evidence without resetting history or duplicating shared referents/resources. Retain unsupported biological mechanisms and update only justified bridges.

cases.title: Long-running growth, corrections and maintenance.
cases.acceptance: Reconnect sources, revise identity/rules, compact/reindex, retain/evict evidence and recover a pinned model cut while the store grows. Bound active memory/queues and count full maintenance/storage costs and unavailable evidence.

cases.title: End-to-end useful speed and inquiry yield.
cases.acceptance: Measure capture/model freshness, eligible useful response latency, validated-answer time, escalation coverage, exploration benefit and complete cost under FAST1/DEV1. Include correct abstention and failed inquiries; an acknowledgement-only or omission-driven speedup does not pass.

cases.acceptance: Requested document ID and configured source handle survive compact C4 context; repeated source versus occurrence identity stays distinct; no redispatch on terminal reopen.

feedback_reviews.analysis: All application owners form a strongly connected logical scheduling/read/proposal group. CONTRACTS.md sections 7â€“8 review generated evidence echoes, temporal leakage, authority escalation, saturation/deadlock, shared model consensus, revision cascades and selection bias with concrete containment. This software SCC does not define a domain causal loop. Version 0.2 additionally reviews high-degree invalidation storms, stale fast decisions, alias/calibration drift, abstraction feedback, selective escalation and repeated access requests; the same eight owners retain authority. Scoped asset delta: generic origins plus omitted transcripts can hide acquired-source identity and contribute to repeated requests; explicit configured document origin improves observability without treating repeated retrieval as independent support. Behavioral improvement is unmeasured. Decision delta: Student and teacher remain blind initially; critique feeds student revision only; native C4 rejection does not pick an action. C0 freezes policy and schedules admitted decisions. Same evidence or advice cannot be promoted to independent observations. Existing bounded stages prevent recursive assistance loops. Actual policy-1.1 live result: the guard prevented repeated complete-source reads, but C4 rejection exhausted the draft corrections before teacher critique. This blocks usable decision-flow qualification; teacher inability or neural-training necessity is not established. Recovery delta: definitely rejected draft reaches teacher critique after completed independent assessment; raw rejection stays generated/unaccepted and is visible to revision. Initial first views remain blind. Memory links raw failure rather than fabricating an admitted draft. Unknown completion cannot enter teaching as rejection; invalid revisions stop before effects. Public manual describes granted names only. Cedar private state and post-terminal outcome vector never enter coaching. Native authored recovery passes; live outcome pending.
